title: Operations management, with practical AI.
intro: I coordinate people, workflows, and tools to keep work moving — and I build practical tools and AI workflows by directing coding agents.
featureText: Four years running review and publishing for a small international studio releasing three times a week, plus Patreon.
secondary: Making client scenarios easier to explain
MapaFinanceiro — a basic interactive tool used by a consórcio team instead of confusing client-facing spreadsheets.
Connecting AI tools with clear controls
Grok MCP Bridge — a personal local integration connecting ChatGPT Chat to Grok Build, with task tracking and separately reviewed changes.
backgroundText: For four years at Michael Ghelfi Studios, I worked across production, editorial standards, publishing, and website operations in an international remote team.
availabilityText: Open to operations management roles on teams hiring remote candidates in Latin America. I am based in Brazil and worked day to day in English with an international remote team for four years.
caseTitle: Keeping recurring production moving across a remote studio
context: Michael Ghelfi Studios is a music and soundscapes studio with a small international team working remotely in English. As Studio Manager I supported three releases per week, plus publishing for Patreon.
responsibilities: Managed a small team through review, feedback, quality control, and standardization.
Edited and published the studio's videos, including Patreon releases.
Maintained the WordPress site and its plugins.
Handled external tools and the studio's social media.
decisions: Editorial themes, video selection, A/B testing, playlists, and AI-generated artwork.
steps: Assembled the full album video from the supplied music
reach: The published video recorded 936,714 views as of 15 September 2026 — a figure for the whole release, including the music and the studio's distribution.
also: I applied a metallic-gold effect to the studio's commissioned black-and-white logo. The original mark was designed by someone else.
